intuition: A max-priority queue exposes the event to poll, while versioned entries make priority changes cheap.

brute_force.approach: Store events in a map and scan all active events for every poll.

optimal.approach: Map active IDs to current priority and version, and keep a lazy heap ordered by priority descending then ID ascending.
optimal.time: updatePriority O(log n), pollHighest O(log n) amortized

edge_cases: Equal priorities choose the smallest event ID.
Heap entries from older priority updates are discarded when they reach the top.
